subject: [PATCH 9/9] mm/gup: unshare-check every page of a pte batch

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where the GUP (get user pages) write pin operation could return stale page content to the pin holder if a later write fault replaced the original page under the pin holder's reference. The fix ensures that every page in a PTE batch is checked for unsharing before being pinned, preventing this issue. This patch addresses a problem where the pin holder could see outdated page data due to concurrent writes by the process owning the pages. With this change, the pin and program address map the same page, ensuring consistency.
